newsletter_description: See "B.I.N.G.O." on May 5th - a play about friendship, community, and unexpected encounters!
description: B.I.N.G.O. (or Brittney Isle's Nice Geriatric Orgy) by Erin Mallon. Directed by Robert Ross Parker. Barb desperately needs friends. That's why she moved to this 55+ community in the first place. So what better way to meet new people than to join a good old fashioned Bingo Night? She thought getting her husband to socialize would be the hardest part of this evening. That is, until she meets Terrance... and his rock hard "assistant." When Bingo Night turns into a full-blown orgy, Barb must decide: does she stay in her safe, predictable world? Or does she play a new game of chance and truly live before it's too late?

newsletter_description: Trenton's celebrity basketball experience with Thunder Games returns for its third year!
description: For the third year, Thunder Games is bringing back its Celebrity Basketball Game, this time with a Space Jam theme. The event takes place on Saturday, March 28, at Thrive Academy in Hamilton. The game starts at 2 p.m. Founders of Thunder Games, Quayshaun Williams, of Much Better Studios, and Momolu Dorley, of Trenton Talks, have put together a team representing each of their individual ventures for a head-to-head competition. The teams are comprised of "regional influencers, creators, entrepreneurs, and community leaders selected during the 2024 draft," according to Thunder Games. Blending competitive basketball with culture, entrepreneurship, and community impact, the event has quickly become one of the most anticipated cultural experiences.

event_name: Soup n’ Story with Bridgette Byrd
newsletter_description: Join a culinary journey blending food, culture, and storytelling with Bridgette Byrd!
description: Participants explored the fundamentals of cooking with a deep dive into mirepoix—the classic blend of onion, carrot, and celery—while preparing a delicious Mediterranean Orzo Soup. Along the way, they discovered the nutritional value, cultural roots, and significance of key ingredients like orzo. This experience invited attendees on a sensory journey—blending food, culture, and storytelling. Through shared memories, hands-on activities, and Bridgette’s own personal reflections, participants explored how soup can serve as a powerful, connective, and even liberatory tool.

newsletter_description: Celebrating Trina Walk Wine with the Sisterhood Award at the Black Women New Jersey gala!
description: Black Women New Jersey is proud to honor Trina Walk Wine as the recipient of our Sisterhood Award at this year’s gala. Trina is more than a beauty and spa specialist, she is a safe space. Through her work, she has poured into countless women, offering not just services, but care, confidence, and connection. From providing haircare, nails and makeup support to simply showing up, she has made women feel seen, valued, and uplifted. For multiple years, Trina has offered free nail services to sisters preparing for the gala, making sure women could show up feeling confident, cared for, and celebrated. What truly sets Trina apart is her heart for this community. When we needed support, she did not hesitate. She used her platform to share and amplify our message, helping us reach hundreds of women and expand our impact. That is who she is. When she sees a need, she steps in. When support is required, she shows up. She is committed to the win of Black Women New Jersey, not just for herself, but for all of us. Her presence, her consistency, and her willingness to pour into others is what sisterhood looks like in action. Trina, we see you. We value you. We appreciate you. We are honored to celebrate Trina and the powerful example she represents.

newsletter_description: Dive into the mind-bending physics of time and entropy with Uncover Quantum!
description: Physics never actually forbids time travel. It just makes it so unlikely it might as well be impossible. ⏰ Here’s the real reason you can never go back in time. It’s not a law. It’s probability. Entropy — the universe’s measure of disorder — always increases. Always. A neat deck of cards has one specific arrangement. Throw them in the air and millions of possible arrangements exist. The mess is statistically overwhelmingly more likely than the order. A glass shatters into a thousand pieces. The pieces never reassemble. Not because physics forbids it — but because there are trillions of ways for pieces to scatter and only one exact way for them to come back together perfectly. The odds are so astronomically against reassembly that it will never happen in the entire lifetime of the universe. That one-way direction — from order to disorder — is what we experience as time. Here’s what genuinely breaks physicists. Every fundamental law of physics works perfectly in both directions. Gravity. Electromagnetism. Quantum mechanics. Film a planet orbiting a star and play it backwards — nothing looks wrong. Every equation still works perfectly. So physics allows time to run backward. Entropy just makes sure it never actually does. The universe isn’t following a rule. It’s playing the odds. And the odds always favour disorder.

newsletter_description: Witness a timeless classic that indicts the Apartheid system. Don't miss Sizwe Banzi Is Dead!
description: One man's death becomes another's salvation in this indictment of South Africa's Apartheid system, which lasted through the 1990s. Sizwe Bansi Is Dead was written by South African playwright Athol Fugard in collaboration with John Kani and Winston Ntshona. Both actors/playwrights, Kani and Ntshona received Tony's in 1975, for their starring roles in the play's Broadway production. The Crossroads production of Sizwe is in collaboration with John Kani, the last remaining member of the writing team.

newsletter_description: Experience the soulful sounds of 3Fold live at Shanghai Jazz!
description: The trio known as 3Fold operates with a refreshing, almost defiant restraint. Drawing from a deep well of soul music traditions, the group’s sound is less about the frantic pace of the moment and more about the resonance of what is left behind. The ensemble’s chemistry is anchored by Eric Brown, whose dual role as drummer and vocalist dictates the band’s rhythmic and melodic DNA. Brown’s steady, purposeful grooves provide a foundation for the fluid low-end of bassist Mike Griot, whose contributions lend the arrangements a grounded, sensitive warmth. Completing the trio is keyboardist John Roggie, whose experience manifests in a sophisticated use of texture. Roggie doesn’t merely play chords, he paints atmospheres, filling the margins with a seasoned sense of timing and taste that honors the genre’s rich history. 3FOLD takes you on a journey; inviting listeners to enjoy the power of musical conversation. Doors open at 4:30 and the first seating ends at 6:15 for a performance at 7:00, second seating begins at 8:35 for the 9:15 performance.
price: $10 music charge per guest. $40 food & drink minimum per person.

newsletter_description: Elevate your craft with an immersive 10-hour master workshop on wood graining!
description: Our second quarter Spring Scenic Workshop happening 5/2/2026 at @odrstudios. Step into a refined, immersive 10-hour master workshop designed for artists, decorative painters, and creatives ready to elevate their craft. This is not a casual class. This is an elevated scenic experience. In this intensive masterclass, you will learn the timeless art of wood graining — from foundational oak techniques to advanced layering, depth creation, and refined finishing methods used in high-end decorative work. Throughout the day, you will: Master classic oak grain patterns, Learn professional glazing control and tool techniques, Explore aging, distressing, and luxury finish options, Gain confidence correcting mistakes like a pro. You’ll work on curated sample boards and finish the day with an overall understanding of how to start your scenic portfolio. This workshop is intentionally designed as a boutique masterclass experience, complete with: Thoughtfully prepared workstations, Live demonstrations (slow + detailed instruction), Guided hands-on execution, Group critique and refinement, Lunch and water breaks, Final showcase and professional photo moments. Whether you are expanding your decorative painting skills or stepping into scenic artistry, this intensive will sharpen your eye, refine your hand, and elevate your artistic confidence. Spots are limited to maintain an intimate, high-level learning environment. If you’re ready to move beyond hobby painting and into true craftsmanship — this workshop is for you.

newsletter_description: Newark's skyline is growing! Construction has officially begun on the 41-story Summit Tower.
description: Construction has officially begun on the 41-story Summit Tower, located at 200-206 Market Street. Demolition began last year, and while a snowy winter torpedoed a planned groundbreaking ceremony, construction has started to ramp up at the property. Designed by INOA Architects, the 41-story tower will top out at 489ft. A total of 514 residential units are included in the approved plan, which will set aside 20 percent of the units as affordable housing. Summit Tower will also feature a garage with 142 parking spaces for future residents. Summit Tower is planned to be Newark next tallest building by 2028.

newsletter_description: Discover the research proving AI layoffs could destabilize the economy.
description: Research by the University of Pennsylvania and Boston University shows that large-scale automation can reduce economic demand if workers are replaced faster than new jobs are created. Firms gain efficiency and cut costs, but displaced workers lose income, reducing overall spending in the economy. This creates a feedback loop where demand weakens across markets. The research describes this as a structural issue in competitive systems, not something individual firms can solve alone.

newsletter_description: Get to know the POWERFUL Jane, Hannah!
description:
Meet April’s Trainer In Motion: @hannah_balagot. Get to know this POWERFUL Jane.

🔥Describe the vibe of your classes in a few words
Sweaty Joy

🔥How do you motivate your community to find their strength?
I try to remind us all to be present with this moment and get curious about how far we can go. Can I get ONE more? Can I go a LITTLE deeper? And also of course celebrate whatever we got today.

🔥How do you define confidence?
Subliminal knowledge of what’s possible that fuels a thirst for more. Confidence is built from trying things that are uncomfortable or scary and finding out it’s not that bad!

🔥What’s a personal achievement that made you feel unstoppable?
Any time I perform in a musical with tricky lifts and partnering. Once we get it down I feel like a flying squirrel.
